messages:
alex: heads up — for the last ~20m our paging adapter didn't send pages to the primary oncall. customers reported no pings. :rotating_light:
incident-bot: ALERT  PAGER_DELIVERY_FAIL detected for service: notify-pager (failed deliveries > 5)
ops-bot: automation note: paging-adapter subscription lag > 10k, retrying webhook fanout (visible in metrics dashboard)
maya: ugh. which clusters/regions affected? any customer-facing errors?
alex: seen in eu-west-1 and us-central. customer support flagged two P1 tickets where customers said they never got paged. logs show adapter returning 502 from our downstream relay when it tried to fanout.
oncall-eng: I didn't get any page. only got a slack mention from monitoring 5m ago.
sam: grabbing logs now — looks like our pubsub consumer stopped acking for a bit and messages piled up. snippet:
```
ERROR notify-pager: webhook fanout failed status=502 body="Bad Gateway"
consumer: ack failed: write tcp 10.0.0.12:443: write: connection reset by peer
```
jordan: any recent deploys to paging-adapter?
alex: yes there was a small filter change pushed ~30m ago to a routing regex — rolling deploy completed at 1719816000. trying to correlate.
maya: if regex filter mismatches subscription IDs it could drop the publish->subscription mapping and cause backpressure. can we confirm?
sam: confirming: last successful ack timestamp ~1719815600, then gap, then influx of retries. relay returned 502 because connection pool exhausted.
oncall-eng: we switched to SMS fallback in playbook — was that executed? I didn't receive SMS either.
alex: SMS fallback failed because the same adapter is used to fanout to sms-gateway; gateway returned 503 on retry. so both channels impacted.
jordan: mitigation idea: revert the last filter change and restart the consumer pods to clear backlog.
maya: agree. also flip on manual direct-sms proxy to bypass adapter for critical pages. I'll open a quick bypass runbook.
sam: running: kubectl -n notify rollout undo deployment/paging-adapter --to-revision=3 and then kubectl -n notify rollout restart deployment/paging-adapter (doing now)
ops-bot: deploy job started by sam — rollout undo started at 1719817725
incident-bot: NOTE manual page: sending emergency SMS to oncall group via direct-sms-proxy (bypass)
oncall-eng: got SMS now (1719817810) — ping received, thanks.
jordan: after restart, consumer lag dropping from 12k -> 300 in the last 1m. looks promising.
maya: assign follow-ups: 1) postmortem for paging-adapter deploy/regression 2) add end-to-end smoke after routing-filter changes 3) create alert for consumer ack lag threshold (lower)
alex: I'll file a ticket and include customer impact notes (2 customers affected, ~22 minutes of missed pages).
maya: brief customer comms: "We experienced service interruption for paging delivery due to an internal routing change; pages retried and manual fallback applied; impacted window ~20 minutes; no data exposure." can someone draft?
sam: drafting now. also adding repro steps for devs: reproduce by publishing a message with subscription id that mismatches the new regex, observe consumer ack stall and relay 502.
jordan: long-term: add circuit-breaker on fanout to avoid connection pool exhaustion and a separate SMS-only pathway for emergency pages.
alex: thanks team. keeping this thread for live updates — will attach logs + timeline to the ticket.
ops-bot: incident severity set to Sev2, incident channel pinned, runbook link: https://internal/runbooks/paging-adapter
incident-bot: RESOLVED? waiting for confirm — consumer lag is stable and manual fallback sent. please ack closure when customer comms go out.
